name: cavemio-workflow-canvas
title: Workflow canvas
description: Connected steps you can move, inspect and follow as work flows through them.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Nodes are real buttons. Tab reaches every node and control; arrows move focus in supplied reading order. Alt + arrows move a node by 12 canvas pixels. Enter or Space opens details; Escape closes details or cancels a drag.
- Status uses text and icons as well as colour. Running, completion and error updates are announced in a polite live region.
- Reduced motion removes connection pulses, spinning indicators and eased viewport/panel transitions. Direct manipulation stays attached to the pointer.
- The canvas owns touch gestures inside its bounds. The initial zoom stays at least 85% for legibility; on narrow screens, pan to reach other nodes or use Fit for an overview. Focusing a node brings it into view.
- Node positions are remembered locally after dragging. onNodeMove lets you persist them. Remount with a new key to reset a moved layout.
- This is a workflow viewer, not a graph execution engine or connection editor. Your application owns execution, retries and data validation.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: nodes
props.description: – · Unique id, title and x/y canvas coordinates. Optional subtitle, icon, status and detail. Nodes measure 164 × 78px.

props.name: edges
props.type: { id: string; from: string; to: string }[]
props.description: – · Unique connection IDs and source/destination node IDs. Missing endpoints are ignored.

props.name: width / height
props.description: 660 / 340 · Canvas bounds in CSS pixels before zoom. Viewport height is 300px.

props.name: label
props.description: Workflow · Region label and visible canvas heading.

props.name: onNodeMove
props.type: (id: string, position: { x: number; y: number }) => void
props.description: – · Final coordinates after a committed drag. Persist these in your application.

props.name: onNodeSelect
props.description: – · The inspected node ID, or null when its details close.

props.name: className
props.description: – · Additional root classes. Standard div attributes are forwarded.

useCases.title: Automation run views
useCases.description: Show a workflow’s steps and which one is running.

useCases.title: AI agent pipelines
useCases.description: Draw the stages of an agent’s work, with failures kept visible.

useCases.title: Data pipeline status
useCases.description: Sources, transforms and destinations with their current state.

useCases.title: Process maps
useCases.description: Explain how a process works in docs and dashboards.

features.title: Nodes you can move
features.description: Dragging a node moves its connections with it, and the final position is reported so you can save it.

features.title: Pan, zoom and fit
features.description: Drag the background to pan, zoom about the centre, or press Fit to see the whole workflow.

features.title: State from your application
features.description: Queued, running, complete and error. Running steps receive travelling pulses and failures stay visible with their context.

features.title: Inspect any node
features.description: Select a node and a details panel opens below the canvas without shifting it.

features.title: Keyboard and screen readers
features.description: Tab reaches every node, arrows move focus, Alt with the arrows moves a node, and status changes are announced.

features.title: A viewer by design
features.description: It does not run or edit the workflow. Your application owns execution, retries and validation.

states.title: ready / queued
states.description: Each node shows its title, subtitle and state indicator. Connections stay quiet until their source has completed.

states.title: running
states.description: The node’s outline gains colour and a pulse travels down incoming connections from completed steps. Pulses pause offscreen and in hidden tabs.

states.title: complete / error
states.description: Completion resolves to a check and leaves a fine coloured connection. Failure uses an error indicator and keeps the node’s details available.

states.title: move
states.description: Dragging updates a node and all attached SVG paths directly, in canvas coordinates. The final position is reported on release; cancellation restores it.

states.title: pan / zoom
states.description: Nodes and paths share one transform. Zoom stays centred on the viewport; Fit shows the full canvas with padding.

states.title: inspect
states.description: A details panel opens below the canvas and measures its content height. Selecting another node updates the panel without shifting the canvas.
